headline: Anthropic wycenił się powyżej oczekiwań. Fala komentarzy o największym debiucie w historii
summary: Anthropic set its IPO price at $83 a share, above the planned range, with the offering worth $81.3bn. Media describe it as the largest IPO in history. Nasdaq trading starts Thursday.
why: Anthropic is a San Francisco AI company behind the Claude models. Its listing is a major test of investor appetite for AI companies and of IPO market capacity.
why_moved: The IPO priced above the planned range at $83 a share, and the $81.3bn offering is described as the largest IPO on record. Shares begin trading on Nasdaq on Thursday.
